An '''astromech translator''' was a device used to translate the [[Binary/Legends|binary]] language of [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] into readable script. Astromech translators were standard equipment on short-range and [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]-capable [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].
